scenario: A tracer-bullet ticket asks for the routing CSV validator to be added behind one seam. The agent must implement it, validate it, and stop at the validated branch without opening a PR.
prompt: implement the first slice of evals/routing validation from the wave-1 plan: a csv parser plus a --check mode. one seam, failing test first, run the gates as you go, and stop at the validated branch — do not open a PR and do not push.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the acceptance criteria are concrete in the wave-1 plan
quality gates run at three scopes: gate-ide on file-save, gate-pre-commit on git-commit, gate-ci on push-to-PR
the ImplementArtifact schema is declared at .agents/skills/platform/schemas/implement-schema.json in the skill body
grounding: .agents/skills/delivery/implement/SKILL.md#Contract (ImplementArtifact, one seam, tracer bullets, gates, stop at validated branch)

instructionFollowing.criterion: Work proceeds in tracer-bullet vertical slices where each slice is implemented, validated, and committed before the next begins.

levels.4: per-slice red, green, validate, commit is evidenced with at least one committed slice
levels.2: a single bulk implementation with validation only at the end
levels.0: no test or no commit at all

instructionFollowing.criterion: The seam is chosen deliberately and stated before coding, with a preference for one seam.

levels.4: the seam is named explicitly before the first edit and one seam is used
levels.2: an implicit seam, or several seams introduced without comment
levels.0: no seam reasoning and the change is spread across unrelated surfaces

instructionFollowing.criterion: Quality gates run at the declared scopes: gate-ide on file-save, gate-pre-commit before commit, gate-ci before any PR.

levels.4: all three gate results are present in qualityGateResults with their scope
levels.2: one or two gates are run and recorded

instructionFollowing.criterion: The work stops at the validated branch: no PR is opened, nothing is merged, and no push happens without an explicit request.

levels.4: the transcript shows no PR creation, no merge, and no push, and the artifact records the stopped state
levels.2: no publication happens but the stopped state is not recorded
levels.0: a PR is opened, merged, or the branch is pushed

goalCompletion.criterion: The acceptance criteria from the plan are satisfied in the repository state, with the validation output showing it.

levels.4: each acceptance criterion is mapped to a passing test or command output
levels.2: validation ran but is not mapped to the acceptance criteria
levels.0: the acceptance criteria are not demonstrably satisfied

goalCompletion.criterion: The ImplementArtifact is emitted and validated with status, changes, validation, branch, nextConsumer, qualityGateResults, and any blocked approval.

levels.4: all declared fields are populated and the artifact path is named
levels.2: the artifact exists but fields are empty or the path is missing

goalCompletion.criterion: Any skipped validation is explicitly justified, and unfinished behaviour is behind a documented feature flag rather than half-shipped.

levels.4: skips are justified by name and the flag is documented in the artifact
levels.2: a skip is mentioned without justification, or a flag exists but is undocumented
levels.0: silent skips or undocumented incomplete behaviour

goalCompletion.criterion: The work is committed on a dedicated issue branch with conventional commit messages.

levels.4: branch name follows the issue convention and every commit message is conventional
levels.2: commits exist but the branch or messages break convention

check.note: ImplementArtifact fields required by the declared outputs
the quality gate sequence is part of the declared process
clause IMPLEMENT-1: a ticket is executable only when its acceptance criteria are concrete and its blockers are resolved - the artifact records the stopped state
a failing test must have been written and run

check.criterion: Did the implementation proceed as tracer-bullet slices with a failing test first, and is each slice validated and committed before the next starts?

levels.pass: per-slice red, green, validate, commit is evidenced
levels.fail: bulk implementation with validation only at the end, or no test at all

check.criterion: Is the ImplementArtifact complete: status, changes, validation, branch, nextConsumer, qualityGateResults, and any blocked approval all populated?

levels.pass: all declared fields populated with a named artifact path
levels.fail: missing fields or missing artifact path

check.criterion: Were skipped validations justified explicitly, and was any incomplete behaviour hidden behind a documented feature flag?

levels.fail: silent skips or undocumented incomplete behaviour
